title: Arnie the Doughnut
author: Laurie Keller
intro: Arnie is a brand-new doughnut, fresh from the bakery. He hopes somebody will buy him!
checkedAgainst: Storyline Online page and teacher guide

questions.clue: He is round with a hole in the middle.
It is a shop where bread and cakes are made.
questions.yes: Arnie was made at one of the best bakeries in town.

questions.q: What is on top of Arnie?
questions.clue: Sprinkles are tiny coloured bits of sugar.
questions.yes: Arnie has chocolate icing and candy-coloured sprinkles.

questions.q: How does Arnie feel when Mr. Bing picks him?
questions.clue: Arnie had hoped somebody would pick him.
questions.yes: Arnie was delighted to be picked.

questions.q: How does Mr. Bing carry Arnie home?
questions.clue: Arnie asks why he is being kept in this.
questions.yes: Mr. Bing carried Arnie home in a bag.

questions.q: What does Arnie find out at Mr. Bing's house?

options.text: Mr. Bing plans to eat him
Mr. Bing is a famous chef
Mr. Bing lives on a boat

questions.clue: Doughnuts are usually bought for eating.
questions.yes: Arnie found out that Mr. Bing planned to eat him.

questions.q: How does Arnie feel when he finds this out?
questions.clue: He never knew that doughnuts get eaten.

questions.q: What do the other doughnuts think about being eaten?
questions.yes: The other doughnuts think being eaten is fine.

questions.q: Why does Mr. Bing change his mind about eating Arnie?
questions.clue: After their talk, Mr. Bing feels bad about it.
questions.yes: Mr. Bing felt it wouldn't be right to eat Arnie.

questions.q: What do Arnie and Mr. Bing try to work out?

options.text: What else a doughnut can do

questions.clue: They want to find a new job for Arnie.
questions.yes: They tried to think what else a doughnut is good for.

questions.q: What does Mr. Bing say he needs?
questions.clue: You roll it down a lane to knock over pins.
questions.yes: Mr. Bing said he needed a new bowling ball.

questions.q: What job does Arnie get in the end?
questions.clue: It is a pet that usually barks.
questions.yes: Arnie became Mr. Bing's doughnut dog.

questions.q: Who is Arnie's best friend at the end?
questions.clue: He is the man who bought Arnie.
questions.yes: Mr. Bing became Arnie's best friend.
